# PostgreSQL Client Matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-pg18-compatibility-report.mjs. Do not edit directly. -->

This is the retained client surface recorded for BicDB 1.0.140-beta against PostgreSQL
18.4. Current source version: BicDB 1.0.438-beta; this presentation
update does not constitute a new client run. `cross_target` entries run the same assertions against BicDB and
the pinned PostgreSQL oracle. `bicdb_regression` entries are repository tests against BicDB only and
must not be presented as a cross-target gauntlet.

## Automated

| Client | Version | Scope | Formats | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| psql | host PostgreSQL client | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text | Scalar values and result OIDs against BicDB and PostgreSQL 18.4 |
| node-postgres | 8.16.3 | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text and driver-safe binary | DDL, CRUD, rollback, named prepared statements, scalar values, and result OIDs |
| psycopg | 3.2.9 | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text and binary | DDL, CRUD, rollback, prepared execution, exact numeric, and temporal migrations |
| SQLAlchemy with psycopg | 2.0.41 / 3.2.9 | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | driver managed | Engine and session flows, DDL, CRUD, rollback, and bound parameters |
| SQLx | 0.8.6 | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text and binary | Canonical text values and typed extended-protocol decoding |
| PostgreSQL JDBC | 42.7.7 | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text and forced binary | Typed getters with binary transfer disabled and forced |
| libpq | host PostgreSQL library | BicDB + PostgreSQL 18.4 | text and binary | PQexecParams plus raw network-byte assertions |
| tokio-postgres | 0.7.18 | BicDB regression | text and binary | In-process BicDB DDL, CRUD, rollback, prepared statements, and typed decoding |

## Manual Or Known Gaps

| Client | Version | Status | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Prisma | 6.10.1 | known_gap | Reproducible db pull smoke; not part of the passing automated matrix |
| DBeaver, DataGrip, and TablePlus | operator supplied | manual | Connection browser and shared SQL smoke script |

Run the cross-target matrix with `./scripts/client-gauntlet.sh`. Run the tokio-postgres BicDB
regression with:

```bash
cargo test -p bicdb-pgwire tokio_postgres_basic_orm_client_gauntlet -- --nocapture
```

See [`docs/postgresql-client-gauntlet.md`](postgresql-client-gauntlet.md) for prerequisites and GUI
smoke instructions.
